incremental_pipeline.scope: local real SQLite, Processor/Main/Social ownership pipeline, real Assembler/Composer, HTTPX MockTransport; no paid provider, platform message or production read
incremental_pipeline.measurement: exact operation counts and byte/hash, not elapsed latency or p95; SQL body counter includes all pipeline chat_events body selects; scope counter is actual EventRecord body materialization in scope_repository
boundaries: plugin and non-tail phases prepare/compose only, zero physical model requests; no inferred payment/cache hit
real pipeline regression separately compared every assembled/compiled byte with prior full-tail renderer oracle
non-tail R is actual affected metadata IDs, not old body re-render count
final message materialization/JSON encoding remains O(P) in public bytes; hashes are output evidence, not upstream cache evidence
pending/refs captured by original H/head; SQLite Event-barrier concurrent-admission regression independently passed
